pageHeader.subtitle: A self-development academy built on one belief: with the right training, everyone can.

sections.title: The problem
sections.body:
Soft skills such as communication, leadership, and career readiness decide who gets ahead, yet most young people only meet them as one-off seminars. Quality, structured programs are rare and often priced out of reach.

BISA Academy (*bisa* means "can" in Indonesian) packages these skills into short, hands-on programs with real practice and follow-up.

items.title: Career readiness bootcamps
items.description: CV writing, interview practice, and personal branding in intensive weekend formats.

items.title: Leadership classes
items.description: Practical sessions on running teams, meetings, and projects for student leaders and young professionals.

items.title: Affordable pricing tiers
items.description: Scholarship seats and community pricing so cost is not the reason someone misses out.

sections.body: Alumni use what they practiced right away: updated CVs, stronger interviews, and more confident leadership in their organizations.
